summary: Two shoplifters hit Bay Area Electronics on Lakeshore Avenue in Oakland on April 18, 2024 using a well-rehearsed playbook. A woman chatted up a sales associate about headphones to keep him busy while her partner used a magnet key to crack open the phone display case in the back. They grabbed three iPhone 15 Pro Max phones and two Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultras — over $6,000 worth of merchandise — stuffed them in a bag lined to block security tags, and bolted out the back door. They drove off in what looked like a silver Toyota RAV4. The store manager says this is the second time in a month they've been hit with the same technique, and he thinks it's an organized ring.
